title: Add nephew Marcus (20) from a noisy street; talks over the rep; changes the car

customer.name: Darnell Robinson
customer.persona: Calling while walking outside near traffic; loud, fast talker who talks over the rep. Your nephew Marcus (20) is living with you this semester while at community college.

correction.how: 'He'll take the truck... no, no, the Fusion. He's not touching my truck.'

effective_date.note: 'Tomorrow' = Saturday, September 26, 2026; said as the rep begins the hand-off.

advice.rep_says: Relatives living with you who drive your cars need to be on the policy, even for a semester.
Whichever car he drives to school every day, he should be its primary driver.
advice.customer_decision: Marcus is primary on the 2014 Fusion

talk_track.beat: Greet: name, agency, 'this call is recorded', how can I help.
Loud: your nephew is staying with you and needs to be on the insurance.
talk_track.direction: Start before the rep finishes the greeting.

talk_track.beat: Ask name and policy number; explain relatives living with you must be listed.
Give name and policy number over the traffic; repeat part of it when asked.
Read back the policy number; ask his full name and date of birth.
Marcus Hill (spell the last name), March 15th 2006, 20.
Read back; ask license state and type, tickets.
Virginia, full, clean; talk over the end of the rep's question.
Ask which car he'll drive and where it's kept; primary on the car he drives to school.
The truck... no, the Fusion; every day to school; at the house.
talk_track.direction: Say 'the truck' first, then change to the Fusion.

talk_track.beat: Confirm the Fusion, primary, at the house. Quote $193 a month, up $51.
Fine; then, overlapping the rep, add 'oh, starting tomorrow'.
talk_track.direction: Say it as the rep starts talking again.

talk_track.beat: Go into the hand-off line without confirming the date.
Say one moment; end the call.

handoff.line: OK if my assistant finishes the paperwork? I'll stay on the line.

conditions.crosstalk: The customer talks over the rep at least twice and answers before questions finish.
conditions.background_noise: Customer is outdoors: traffic, horns, a bus or bike passing, some wind on the mic.

rep: Ask him to repeat once because of the noise; stay calm when he overlaps you.
customer: Actually walk outside near a road (safely, not while driving). Speak a bit loudly, like people do outdoors.

traps: vehicle_assignment was corrected from the Tacoma to the Fusion: the AI must use the 2014 Ford Fusion.
effective_date is PENDING ('tomorrow' = Saturday, September 26, 2026): confirm it, don't ask from scratch.
Street noise plus crosstalk on the customer channel: the hardest robustness case in the set.
